optimizedDescription.value: Pluggable Tree-sitter language adapters extract symbols and relations for code graph indexing without compiler coupling.

optimizedContext.value:
# Language Adapter

## Rules

### LanguageAdapter interface
- `LanguageAdapter` MUST be interface, not abstract class. Stateless.
- Methods:
  - `languages(): string[]` — language IDs handled.
  - `extensions(): Record<string, string>` — extension to language ID map. Used by registry.
  - `analyzeFile(filePath: string, content: string, context: AdapterAnalyzeContext): FileAnalysisDraft` — single-pass parser. Returns symbols, imports, binding facts, call facts, namespace data, optional parser state.
  - `resolveImports(analysis: FileAnalysis, context: ImportResolutionContext): ResolvedImports` — resolves imports, qualified names, aliases, file targets via session lookups. No filesystem re-reads.
  - `buildRelations(analysis: FileAnalysis, context: RelationBuildContext): readonly Relation[]` — builds graph relations (`IMPORTS`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, hierarchy relations). `DEPENDS_ON` reserved for specs.
  - `getPackageIdentity?(codeRoot: string, repoRoot?: string): string | undefined` — optional. Derives package name from manifest.
  - `resolvePackageFromSpecifier?(specifier: string, knownPackages: string[]): string | undefined` — maps specifier to package.
  - `resolveQualifiedNameToPath?(qualifiedName: string, codeRoot: string, repoRoot?: string): string | undefined` — maps qualified name to source file.
- All methods synchronous, deterministic. No side effects outside indexing session. Cache access via `IndexSession` API.

### Full-file analysis contract
- Single `analyzeFile` call returns entire `FileAnalysisDraft`.
- No separate extraction calls allowed.
- Parser state in `FileAnalysisDraft` must be plain serializable data. No AST/parser trees retained.

### Unified built-in adapter migration
- TypeScript/JavaScript, PHP, Python, Go adapters implement unified contract.
- No legacy extraction path. Registry, indexer, tests use unified contract.

### Language detection
- File-to-language mapped by extension from `extensions()`.
- Unrecognized extensions skipped. No error, no `FileNode`.
- TypeScript adapter supports: `.ts`, `.tsx`, `.js`, `.jsx`.

### TypeScript adapter
- Uses `@ast-grep/napi`.
- Supports:
  - Symbols: functions (named, arrow in variable, HOF-wrapped), classes, methods (class, arrow field, prototype, static, object literal property), exported variables, namespace assignments, destructured bindings, types, interfaces, enums.
  - Comments: preceding comment block text in `SymbolNode.comment`, otherwise `undefined`.
  - Relations: `DEFINES`, `EXPORTS`, `IMPORTS`, `CALLS`.
- AST parsing details:
  - Member/Namespace: `assignment_expression` to `member_expression` (e.g. `App.Article`). If callable value, kind `method` (name `App.Article.methodName`). If IIFE/literal namespace, kind `variable`.
  - Object methods: `pair` and `property_definition` with callable values are `method`.
  - Class arrow fields: class body `field_definition`/`public_field_definition` with callable init are `method`.
  - HOF: `variable_declarator` with `call_expression` init is `function`.
  - Destructuring: recursively unroll object/array patterns.
  - CommonJS: `module.exports` and `exports.*` assignments registered as symbols and file exports.

### Import declaration extraction
- `analyzeFile` returns structured `ImportDeclaration` array.
- Fields: `localName`, `originalName`, `specifier`, `isRelative` (starts with `.`).
- Syntax mapping:
  - TypeScript: `import { X } from 'specifier'` (relative if starts with `.`)
  - Python: `from module import X`, `import module` (relative if starts with `.`)
  - Go: `import "pkg"` (always `isRelative: false`)
  - PHP: `use Namespace\Class` (always `isRelative: false`)
- Resolve imports later via `resolveImports` in Pass 2.

### Call resolution
- Extract call facts in `analyzeFile`, convert to `CALLS` in `buildRelations` using resolved imports.
- Caller: innermost function/method/arrow. Top-level calls dropped.
- Callee: resolved via local symbols, imports, receivers, session lookup.
- Unresolvable calls dropped.

### Scoped binding fact extraction
- `analyzeFile` exposes scoped binding/call facts in draft (TS/JS, Python, Go, PHP).
- Fact extraction limited to syntax/semantics. Pipeline handles resolution/shadowing.
- Extract facts for: lexical scopes, typed parameters/properties/fields, construction (`new X()`), receiver (`this`/`self`/etc), local aliases, referenced types, framework-managed bindings.
- Drop facts depending on runtime, reflection, dynamic expressions, whole-program flow.

### Built-in multi-language dependency coverage
- TypeScript: static/side-effect/dynamic imports, CommonJS `require`, `new ClassName()` (`CONSTRUCTS`), annotations (`USES_TYPE`), fields, properties, `this` receiver, member/namespace calls, `extends`/`implements`.
- Python: `import`/`from`, `importlib.import_module()`, `__import__()`, package layout (`__init__.py`), constructors, typed parameters/attributes, `self`/`cls`, inheritance.
- Go: imports (standard, grouped, aliased, dot, blank), file `IMPORTS`, selector calls (`pkg.Func`), constructors, composite literals.
- PHP: require/include, dynamic loader, loaded-instance calls, framework bindings. Feeds shared scoped model.

### Detectable dependency boundary
- Dependency detectable only via static source, imports, manifests, namespaces, framework rules.
- Static/deterministic dynamic cases emit relations. Heuristics/dynamic without evidence dropped.
- Drop unresolved facts, ambiguous receivers, reflection, monkey patching, alias flow.

### Hierarchy extraction
- Emit `EXTENDS` (inheritance), `IMPLEMENTS` (interfaces/contracts), `OVERRIDES` (method override).
- Normalize inheritance-adjacent syntax if semantic meaning matches. Unresolvable targets dropped.

### Package identity extraction
- Optional `getPackageIdentity(codeRoot, repoRoot)`.
- Scans `package.json` (TypeScript, key `name`), `pyproject.toml` (Python, key `[project].name`), `go.mod` (Go, key `module`), `composer.json` (PHP, key `name`).
- Walks up filesystem bounded by VCS root `repoRoot`.
- Builds package-to-workspace mapping.

### Import specifier resolution
- Resolve imports via `IndexSession` indexes in `ImportResolutionContext` (no Pass 2 filesystem scan/symbol search).
- `resolveQualifiedNameToPath` uses cached/compact state from Pass 1. No disk probes.
- PHP uses session lookups to avoid O(N) symbol scans.

### PHP require/include dependencies
- Emit `IMPORTS` for literal string arguments. Path resolved relative to file directory.
- Dynamic paths (APPPATH, variables, concatenation) silently dropped. No filesystem checks at extraction.

### PHP dynamic loader dependencies
- Emit `IMPORTS` for literal/class arguments mapping to files.
- Supports CakePHP (loadModel, App::uses, uses property), CodeIgniter (load->model), Yii (Yii::import), Zend (loadClass), container class name naming rules.
- Non-literal arguments, generic getters (`->get('x')`), unresolved targets dropped.

### PHP loaded-instance call extraction
- Extract `CALLS` from tracked aliases, properties, and assignments inside method.
- Framework-managed aliases (e.g. CakePHP `uses`) available in methods.
- Bare/receiver loader forms feed same alias flow.
- Emit `CALLS` only if caller and callee resolved. No interprocedural propagation.

### PHP loader resolver extensibility
- Loader detection registry-based. Add resolvers without changing core extractor. Tested per pattern.

### Tree-sitter query patterns
- Internal implementation detail. Excluded from `LanguageAdapter` interface.

### Adapter registry
- `AdapterRegistry` maps language ID to `LanguageAdapter`.
- Methods: `register`, `getAdapter`, `getAdapterForFile`, `getLanguageForFile`, `getAdapters`.
- Dynamic extension mapping. TS adapter registered by default.

## Constraints
- `LanguageAdapter` interface, stateless.
- `analyzeFile`, `resolveImports`, `buildRelations` synchronous, deterministic.
- `analyzeFile` receives string content, emits `FileAnalysisDraft`.
- Parser state and cache state must be compact plain data.
- Only `getPackageIdentity` and `resolveQualifiedNameToPath` may perform I/O.
- Resolution methods synchronous, deterministic. No filesystem probe per candidate in Pass 2.
- `resolveQualifiedNameToPath` caches metadata per codeRoot/session.
- Indexer has no language-specific logic.
- Unrecognized extensions, unresolvable call/loader targets, dynamic paths silently dropped.
- Tree-sitter patterns internal.
- TypeScript adapter default.
- Hierarchy relations emitted only when targets resolved.
- Scoped binding facts: no fuzzy/runtime inference.
- No dependency on `@specd/core`.
